full_episode_prompt: Open on a quiet mountain dawn. Mist fills the deep valley below a tiny wooden home built into a lush cliff, with a narrow waterfall falling beside it. Warm lamplight glows in the small window as An opens the wooden shutters and looks out at the sunrise. Tro, a smoky gray cat with one white front paw, stretches slowly on the windowsill. May, a golden honey-colored dog, waits at the doorway while An kneels and gently ties a pale blue scarf around his neck. She hands him a small empty woven basket. May takes the basket handle carefully in his mouth and steps out onto the narrow wooden bridge. End with May reaching the far side of the bridge, turning once to look back at the small glowing home across the mist. Preserve An's identity, May's golden fur and pale blue scarf, Tro's smoky gray fur and white front paw, and the same house architecture.
